title: Sphere recovered from a crashed craft
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: started talking about that it was recovered in a from a a craft that had crashed they said that they did say that

plain: At Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana, a sphere was shown in 2014 that the people there said had been recovered from a craft that had crashed. A man named Randy Anderson, who says he saw alien technology at a military base, tells Jesse Michels he was there and heard them say it, which, if true, would point to the military holding parts from crashed craft.
